items.headline: Ole Miss expects RB Kewan Lacy to play vs. Charlotte
items.description: Ole Miss running back Kewan Lacy will dress out and is expected to play in Saturday night's game vs. Charlotte, coach Pete Golding said.

items.headline: Golding praises Rebels' resilience, but demands execution, smarts
items.description: Pete Golding appreciates his players' "competitive greatness" in response to adversity but says Ole Miss must come together more and avoid the need for a comeback.

items.headline: Mississippi coach Pete Golding aims to eradicate erratic play in Week 2 against Charlotte
items.description: — After erratic play nearly cost No. 9 Mississippi in its season opener, coach Pete Golding has made consistency an over-arching theme while preparing for Saturday's home opener against Charlotte.

items.headline: Michigan falls out of AP Top 25 college football poll after win
items.description: LSU moved into the top 10 in the AP Top 25 college football poll, while Michigan fell out of the rankings after its victory on a last-second Hail Mary vs. Western Michigan.
